description: A local image generation tool: presets, seeds and styles to iterate fast and keep results reproducible.

sections.title: The tool
sections.content:
I wanted a generator that behaves like a real tool: launch, iterate, keep a result, restart from a seed… without relying on the cloud.

  • Presets + seeds to reproduce a result exactly.
  • Simple workflow: run → compare → export.
  • Everything runs locally, with progress that stays readable.

sections.title: What I built
sections.content:
• Pipeline + orchestration (queue, cancel, feedback) with a clear UX.
  • Practical controls: styles, variations, minimal history for reproducibility.
  • Simple optimisations to keep the tool pleasant to use.
